name: Securities Account 8
definition: Provides information about the securities account.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the value is a debit or credit.

AccountOwnerIdentification.name: Account Owner Identification
AccountOwnerIdentification.definition: Identification of the party that owns the account.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Idenfitication of the account where financial instruments are maintained.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies the corporate action options available to the account owner.

OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Number identifying the available corporate action options.

SecurityHoldingForm.name: Security Holding Form
SecurityHoldingForm.definition: Specifies the form of the financial instrument.

StampDuty.name: Stamp Duty
StampDuty.definition: Specifies if the stamp duty is applicable.
